title: Builder BLD-103: Spine and outline

source.ref: Owner approval 2026-11-02: build the next-gen builder from the role and block contracts. BLD-103.

detail:
B1 Shell, pass BLD-103 (spec: docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md#bld-103). Spine and outline. Scope: components/builder/spine. Build: Spine reads the node tree: one thumbnail per section, selected state, drag to reorder, + between. Outline drawer: section names from role intent and the title slot, hidden-on-device dimming. Done when: Reorder by drag and by keyboard produces the same document; Doc-safety corpus round-trips after reorder. Gates: vitest suite (required test job), check:node-document-safety, a11y ratchet, Pass probes, check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions. After: BLD-102. Loop: build, validate, repair (3 cycles, classes in EDITOR-NEXT.md), record.

Spine and outline read one list (lib/builder/spine.ts): block label as the intent, title slot as the line, dimmed where hidden on the device. Reorder by drag (outline and canvas) and by Alt plus an arrow goes through one pure move; the corpus test over every kit page proves drag equals keyboard, zero loss and an exact round trip. The + between sections arrives with add by intent (BLD-201).
